nodes.title: Note: Yue2 Song Generator
widgets_values:
## YuE2 Song Generator

[YuE2-3B](https://huggingface.co/m-a-p/YuE2-3B) is the m-a-p team's open lyrics-to-song model — give it lyrics and a style description and it generates a full song with vocals and accompaniment, 48kHz stereo, with an editable melody/chord score layer. It's strong enough to outscore Suno v5 on the WildSongBench benchmark.

This workflow adds two things on top:
- **SongScribe Style Preset node** (mine): pick a style from a dropdown and it fills in the style description for you, so you don't have to write it out each time.
- **SheetSage2**: optional — upload an existing song and it pulls the background music / melody into a score you can use to seed your new song.

### Models
- [yue2_3b_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/YuE2/tree/main/checkpoints) -> ComfyUI/models/checkpoints/
- [sheetsage2_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/YuE2/tree/main/audio_encoders) -> ComfyUI/models/audio_encoders/
Both from [Comfy-Org/YuE2](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/YuE2). Model page: [m-a-p/YuE2-3B](https://huggingface.co/m-a-p/YuE2-3B).

### Custom node
SongScribe (for the style preset node): https://github.com/TheLocalLab/ComfyUI-SongScribe
Just published to the Comfy Registry, so it may take a day or two to appear in ComfyUI Manager — if it's not there yet, clone it manually into custom_nodes and restart.

### Notes
- Runs on ~24GB VRAM (a few-minute song in ~1-2 min on a 4090).
- Use the Fast Groups Bypasser to toggle the SheetSage2 melody-copy path on/off.

## YuE2 Song Generator

[YuE2-3B](https://huggingface.co/m-a-p/YuE2-3B) is the m-a-p team's open lyrics-to-song model — give it lyrics and a style description and it generates a full song with vocals and accompaniment, 48kHz stereo, with an editable melody/chord score layer. It's strong enough to outscore Suno v5 on the WildSongBench benchmark.

- **SheetSage2**: optional — upload an existing song and it pulls the background music / melody into a score you can use to seed your new song.

### Models
- [yue2_3b_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/YuE2/tree/main/checkpoints) -> ComfyUI/models/checkpoints/
- [sheetsage2_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/YuE2/tree/main/audio_encoders) -> ComfyUI/models/audio_encoders/
Both from [Comfy-Org/YuE2](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/YuE2). Model page: [m-a-p/YuE2-3B](https://huggingface.co/m-a-p/YuE2-3B).

### Custom node
